items.heading: Grapevine Daily Quote November 7
items.text: It is our experience as alcoholics that makes us of unique value ... We can approach sufferers as no one else can.
items.attribution: “A United Message of Recovery,” Decatur, Georgia, May 1994, AA Grapevine

items.heading: Cita Diaria con La Viña Noviembre 7
items.text: La felicidad no es una estación a la que llegamos, sino una forma de viajar.
items.attribution: “Paso a paso”. MAYO DE 1953. Del AA Grapevine
